Definition: Jegar-Sahadutha, a cairn East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Jegar-sahadutha is the name Laban gave to the heap of stones he and Jacob raised as a witness between them. Laban called it by the Aramaic name, but Jacob called it Galeed, and the two names stand side by side on the same stones.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a heap of stones can be a covenant, and the witness between Laban and Jacob still stands east of the Jordan.
